sentences.text: Heard Mr. R. De, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. SH Bora, learned Addl.
Public Prosecutor for the State respondent No. 1.

This is an application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., filed by the petitioner praying for setting aside and quashing the proceedings of PRC No. 2214/2021 (arising out of Dispur P.S. Case No. 2036/2021)
under Section 498A IPC, pending in the Court of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (M),
Guwahati.

entities.text: Court of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (M)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Issue notice to the respondent No. 2.
The petitioner shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent No. 2 by registered post with A/D as well as usual process, returnable within 4 weeks.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that another FIR has been lodged by the respondent No 2 in the same set of incident, which was registered as Bilasipara P.S. Case No. 768/2021 (Corresponding to PRC Case No. 243/2023) under Section 498(A) IPC, pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bilasipara, Dhubri.

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bilasipara, Dhubri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Call for the scanned copies of LCRs of both the cases from the concerned Courts.
No formal notice is required to be served upon the respondent No. 1 as Ms. SH Bora has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of respondent No. 1.
Page No.# 3/3 List the matter after 4 weeks.

Till returnable date further proceedings of PRC Case No. 243/2023 (arising out of Bilasipara P.S.
Case No. 768/2021) under Section 498(A) IPC, pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bilasipara, Dhubri is stayed.
